name: ghcr-tag-sizes
description: Firefox/Chrome extension that shows per-architecture layer sizes for GHCR tags on GitHub package pages.

scripts.lint: npm run build:dirs && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox --no-config
scripts.dev:firefox: npm run build:dirs && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox --start-url https://github.com/orgs/clevyr/packages/container/package/scaffold
scripts.dev:chrome: npm run build:dirs && web-ext run --target chromium --source-dir dist/chrome --start-url https://github.com/orgs/clevyr/packages/container/package/scaffold
scripts.e2e:firefox: npm run build:dirs && node test/e2e/run.mjs firefox
scripts.e2e:chrome: npm run build:dirs && node test/e2e/run.mjs chrome
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:firefox && npm run e2e:chrome
